name: Waterskin
description: Treated leather skin; holds water or worse.

name: Firebloom salve
description: Warms frostbitten limbs back to life.

name: Chain (per meter)
description: Heavy iron links, sold by the meter.

name: Padded gambeson
description: Quilted cloth armor; better than nothing.

name: Coil of hempen rope
description: Sturdy rope, frayed at one end, useful for climbing or binding.

name: Whetstone
description: Worn smooth from sharpening a hundred blades.

name: Leather satchel
description: Weathered brown leather, reinforced stitching, still holds secrets.

name: Flint and steel
description: Strike them together to summon a spark in darkness.

name: Iron file
description: Rough and ancient, teeth worn but still capable of shaping metal.

name: Bone dice
description: Carved from yellowed bone, one die favors fives suspiciously.

name: Ink vial
description: Dark liquid that stains permanently; a scribe's blood.

name: Quill and feather
description: Goose feather nib, scratches against parchment with quiet authority.

name: Brass compass
description: Needle still points north, though rust creeps at its edges.

name: Steel lockpick set
description: Six slender tools, one bent from rough use, still sharp enough for locks.

name: Silver locket
description: Tarnished but intact; inside, a portrait too faded to recognize.

name: Grappling hook
description: Four iron prongs, weight-tested and reliable for scaling walls.

name: Tin lantern
description: Dents suggest it has been dropped from horseback; still holds flame.

name: Chain links
description: Iron chain, well-forged, rattles with promise and menace.

name: Worn journal
description: Half-filled pages in cramped handwriting; previous owner's secrets scatter within.

name: Silk scraps
description: Fine royal blue and crimson threads, precious remnants of wealth.

name: Gemstone, uncut
description: Pale emerald clouded by inclusions, yet unmistakably a fortune waiting.

name: Copper coin purse
description: Canvas pouch holds the common man's wealth: seventeen tarnished coins.

name: Healing tincture
description: Amber liquid that glows faintly; restores 2d6+3 HP when ingested.

name: Wayfarer's bread
description: Hard-baked loaf that tastes of ash and necessity; sustains travel for one day.

name: Wispwort oil
description: Pale green liquid that smells of moonlight; increases vision range to 60 meters for two hours.

name: Salted meat
description: Jerky cured in brine; harsh on the tongue but preserves well.

name: Moonpetal extract
description: Milky essence of night-blooming flowers; neutralizes any single poison when applied.

name: Venom antidote
description: Murky draught made from fangs and roots; cures venom sickness within an hour.

name: Honey jar
description: Golden sweetness thick as amber; a peasant's treasure and healer's aid.

name: Eldritchwood ash
description: Fine gray powder that smells of burnt starlight; sprinkled, it reveals invisible spirits.

name: Mead flask
description: Leather flask of honey-wine, warming to belly and courage alike.

name: Fortifying broth
description: Rich soup of bone and herbs; grants +2 to all physical actions for one day.

name: Scarlet root powder
description: Crimson dust that causes mild visions; chewed, it dulls pain for three hours.

name: Dried herbs bundle
description: Tied sage, thyme, and rosemary; brewed as tea, steadies a trembling hand.

name: Crystalline salt
description: Pure white crystals that taste of the sea; preserves meat and repels certain spirits.

name: Vigor elixir
description: Crimson liquid that pulses like a heartbeat; restores exhaustion and grants temporary strength.

name: Rendered lard
description: Pale fat in a clay pot, essential for cooking and lamp-light alike.

name: Cleansing balm
description: Milky salve that smells of ash-wood; heals infected wounds within a day.

name: Dreamveil tonic
description: Iridescent draught that induces visions; grants insight into one hidden truth when drunk.

name: Smoked fish
description: Dried and darkened by smoke; travels well and tastes of the open sea.

name: Restorative paste
description: Thick brown unguent applied to wounds; regenerates 1d6+1 HP over one hour.

name: Leather jerkin
description: Stiff leather vest, brown with age, still offers basic protection.

name: Padded gambeson
description: Quilted linen jacket stuffed with wool; the common soldier's shield against blades.

name: Chainmail hauberk
description: Linked iron rings forming an overlapping web; clanks with authority.

name: Steel cuirass
description: Shaped metal breastplate of dark steel, polished but not pristine; a knight's core defense.
